title: Walk-away auto lock and pull-away behavior
summary: This topic combines two loosely related subjects: walk-away auto lock and unlock behavior, and comments about pull-away smoothness or responsiveness.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the convenience of phone or card key access and automatic lock or unlock behavior when leaving or approaching the vehicle.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe unsmooth pull-away behavior, especially around stop-start operation, and the examples are insufficient to support a stronger theme.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention walk-away locking, requests to adjust comfort access behavior, and other unrelated uses of words like away or right away without clear sentiment.

limitations: The sampled fragments mix walk-away locking, comfort access preferences, pull-away drivability, and unrelated uses of the word away, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a clear sentiment-specific narrative.
Only a small number of explicit positive and negative examples are available, so some aspects are supported by limited evidence.
